text:
jana: FYI promotion for v3.2.0 is blocked. dozens of runners failing to push artifacts with 401 after token rotation + registry returning 404 for some blobs. canary stopped at 10%. holding.
tom: Ugh. any CI links? which step is erroring?
jana: integration-artifact-upload step. CI job 45122/45123. logs show: `PUT /v2/redwood/runtime/blobs/uploads/ -> 401 unauthorized` then final `404 blob not found` after retries.
deploy-bot: Deploybot automated: canary promotion halted for v3.2.0 - artifact publish failed. See logs: https://ci.company/45122 (raw).
beth: We rotated the registry token earlier to comply with KMS policy. Looks like some runners picked up old creds and retried a lot. That plus cache eviction caused stampede.
sam: short-term: we can re-tag the last-good image v3.1.9 (sha: ef12ab34) as the canary target and pause v3.2.0 rollout. `deploy promote --target sha:ef12ab34 --canary 10` will stop new traffic.
infra-oncall: I'm investigating token propagation. some agents didn't pick up the new secret (k8s secret refresh lag). Ops are pushing a rolling restart to the runner pool now. ETA ~15min.
marcus: Is it safe to just re-tag? will customer telemetry be affected if we pin to older image?
jana: telemetry unchanged, it's just halting the new binary. better than partial rollout with missing blobs.
tom: We also need to update release-notes and slack #release-updates. If we hold the change window (scheduled for 02:00 UTC), we should notify PMs & SREs.
beth: Also, consider forcing artifact cache warm on a few runners instead of all. commands I used before:
```
ci exec --runner warmup --image redwood/runtime:ef12ab34 --precache
```
marcus: If infra fixes secrets quickly, can we resume within the window?
infra-oncall: If token propagation completes in 15 and registry blob availability stabilizes, we can attempt a partial resume. But we should be conservative: re-run the failed artifact-upload jobs first, not resume full traffic.
sam: OK I'll queue reruns with `ci rerun --jobs 45122,45123 --serial` to avoid parallel stampede.
deploy-bot: Deploybot automated: pinned promotion target -> v3.1.9 (sha:ef12ab34). Manual hold on v3.2.0 applied.
jana: Decision: HOLD and pin to v3.1.9. Run serial reruns for uploads. If infra confirms secret propagation within 20m we attempt a controlled resume; otherwise cut hotfix branch from v3.1.9 and schedule promotion tomorrow morning. I'll open PR to update release-notes and add changelog about token rotation fallout.
tom: I'll notify PMs and Sales. marcos (sic) — can you take sales FYI? :slightly_smiling_face: 
marcus: on it.
infra-oncall: continuing to monitor. posting updates in 10.
sam: queued reruns, reducing concurrency.
jana: thanks team. we'll reconvene on-channel in 20. :thumbsup:
